introduction.value: A team used Muse for several days on content management, scheduling, reminders, research and testing private MCP tools, noting odd interfaces, popups, logins and CAPTCHAs can still confuse it.

method.value: The CodeMyPixel team gave Muse, Meta's personal agent, real work for several days: content management, scheduling, reminders and research. outcome.value: The team found it useful because it takes on work instead of only answering questions. Limits: long-running processes can be killed, the remote browser feels slow, and odd interfaces, popups, logins or CAPTCHAs can stall it.

notes.value: Treat it as an assistant that needs supervision on important actions, not something to leave unattended. It also isn't suited to acting as a permanent server, since the sandbox can end long jobs.

source_text.body:
Run content, scheduling, reminders and research with Muse
A team used Muse for several days on content management, scheduling, reminders, research and testing private MCP tools, noting odd interfaces, popups, logins and CAPTCHAs can still confuse it.
Done with
MM
Meta Muse
What they did
The CodeMyPixel team gave Muse, Meta's personal agent, real work for several days: content management, scheduling, reminders and research. Muse runs in its own isolated virtual computer with a browser. They also connected private MCP tools to see whether it could work with their own systems. The review gives no step-by-step examples of specific tasks.
How it went
The team found it useful because it takes on work instead of only answering questions. Limits: long-running processes can be killed, the remote browser feels slow, and odd interfaces, popups, logins or CAPTCHAs can stall it.
Worth knowing
Treat it as an assistant that needs supervision on important actions, not something to leave unattended. It also isn't suited to acting as a permanent server, since the sandbox can end long jobs.
Try it yourself
with
Meta Muse
Copy prompt
Act as my assistant for the next [few days]. Help me with [content planning, scheduling, reminders, and quick research on topics I give you]. For each task, tell me what you did and flag anything that got stuck on a login, popup, or CAPTCHA instead of guessing. Before sending any message, publishing anything, or changing my calendar, show me exactly what you're about to do and wait for my approval.
Original source: https://codemypixel.com/blog/meta-muse-personal-ai-agent-1-billion-tokens
